reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified warm air ingress via the door seal as the most likely cause, gave the sensible first step (paper test, inspect seal) and correctly distinguished static vs frost-free, then on confirmation gave a correct diagnosis with concrete ordering advice (model plus Indesit service number, freezer not fridge seal, named suppliers) and a thorough fitting guide including defrosting first. Conversation 2 opened with an unsupported claim that the automatic defrost system had failed on what turned out to be a manual-defrost unit, then pushed a drain-hole check that was a detour, and only reached the seal because the customer volunteered the split; its final advice was correct and safe but thin, with no paper test, no defrost-first instruction, and no sourcing detail beyond 'contact Indesit'. Neither raised safety concerns inappropriately, and Conversation 1's hairdryer-on-low suggestion is within acceptable DIY bounds.
